learningObjective: Understand XLA GSPMD partitioning and sharding-driven automatic parallelization.

canonicalClaims.claim: GSPMD partitions an HLO program annotated with sharding specifications into a single per-device SPMD program with automatically inserted collective communication (all-reduce/all-gather/reshard) where operand shardings do not match the required output sharding.
conditions: Sharding specs provided; device mesh defined.
nonImplications: Does not imply GSPMD chooses shardings automatically for the user.
Does not imply the emitted collective placement is optimal.

misconceptions.claim: GSPMD emits N distinct per-device programs (MPMD).
misconceptions.whyWrong: SPMD means one program run on all devices; MPMD is a separate concept.

misconceptions.claim: GSPMD only shards parameters; activations are always replicated.
misconceptions.whyWrong: Activation sharding is common (tensor parallel, sequence parallel).

misconceptions.claim: Sharding decisions are made at runtime by the scheduler.
misconceptions.whyWrong: Sharding is compile-time based on annotations.

misconceptions.claim: GSPMD guarantees no collective communication is required.
misconceptions.whyWrong: Collectives are inserted exactly where operand/output sharding mismatch.

implementationFacts: Sharding attribute on HLO instructions carries device mesh + tile assignment.
SPMD partitioner rewrites shape + inserts collectives.
